- `nm_i` = NAND(c_i, c_i) = NOT(c_i)
- `nr_i` = NAND(c_{i+1}, c_{i+1}) = NOT(c_{i+1})
- `or_i` = NAND(nm_i, nr_i) = c_i OR c_{i+1}
- `t1_i` = NAND(c_{i-1}, or_i)
- `t2_i` = NAND(c_{i-1}, t1_i)
- `t3_i` = NAND(or_i, t1_i)
- `x_i` = NAND(t2_i, t3_i)

The last four gates construct an XOR gate between `c_{i-1}` and `or_i`.

$x_i = c_{i-1} \text{ XOR } (c_i \text{ OR } c_{i+1})$
